_comment: The address of every deployed Worker, per environment. ONE source of truth,
read by .github/scripts/verify-deploy.sh and by
services/api/test/db-identity.test.ts.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. Both of those hardcoded a workers.dev hostname pattern.
On 16 Aug 2026 the api.marginsheet.com route was added to wrangler.jsonc,
Cloudflare disabled the workers.dev hostname for that Worker as it does
whenever explicit routes are declared, and two blocking checks went red
against an address nobody reaches while production itself was healthy.
EVERY ENTRY HAS THE SAME SHAPE, DELIBERATELY: an origin that answers, and a
path per purpose. A CONSUMER RESOLVES origin + paths[purpose] AND BRANCHES ON
NOTHING. The first version of the proxy change made a value sometimes a
string and sometimes an object, which put the rule in every reader instead of
in the shape, and the second reader got it wrong immediately: verify-deploy.sh
does `origin + '|' + target` and threw TypeError on dev and staging. Two
consumers is cheap to fix; five would not be.
WHERE A WORKER IS PRIVATE, ITS origin IS api's AND ITS PATHS ARE api's PROXY
ROUTES. Nothing in this file says 'private' and nothing needs to: how a
service is reached is the only question, and the answer is the same shape
either way. What is private is declared in config/public-surface.json and
verified against the live surface.
conversation is direct in production only until api's proxy deploys there.
See retract-workers-dev-staging-production in docs/open-items.json.
